_comment: watch-video-max example config. Copy this file to .watch-video.json in your working directory, or to ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/watch-video/config.json for a user-global default, then edit the values you want to pin. JSON has no comment syntax, so every real key has a sibling '_comment_<key>' key describing it -- the '_comment_*' keys themselves are ignored by the loader. Every key is OPTIONAL: omit anything you want auto-detected or defaulted, and delete the '_comment_*' keys once you no longer need them. Environment variables (WV_*) always take priority over anything in this file. See README.md for the full resolution order. This file is shared with the sibling packages 'watch-video' and 'video-autopsy': unknown keys are ignored silently by whichever package does not use them.
_comment_python: Path to (or bare name of) a python3 interpreter that has faster-whisper installed. If omitted, auto-detection tries python3 on PATH, then $CONDA_PREFIX/bin/python3, then common conda/venv locations, picking the first one that can 'import faster_whisper'. Falls back to a bare 'python3' if none of those succeed.
_comment_ffmpeg: ffmpeg binary. Auto-detected via 'command -v ffmpeg' if omitted.
_comment_ffprobe: ffprobe binary. Auto-detected via 'command -v ffprobe' if omitted.
_comment_ytdlp: yt-dlp invocation: either a path/name of the yt-dlp binary, or a 'python -m yt_dlp' style string. Only needed when analyzing a URL instead of a local file. Auto-detected via 'command -v yt-dlp', then '<python> -m yt_dlp' if the yt_dlp module is importable.
_comment_js_runtime: Path to a JS runtime (deno or node) that yt-dlp needs for reliable YouTube extraction. Auto-detected via 'command -v deno' then 'command -v node'. Leave empty/omitted to skip passing a --js-runtimes flag to yt-dlp entirely.
_comment_work_dir: Scratch directory for extracted frames and audio. Needs several GB of free space, scaling with max_fps -- roughly 12 GB for a 60-minute source at the default 5 fps. Defaults to ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/watch-video-max.
_comment_output_dir: Directory where finished deliverables are written. Defaults to $HOME/watch-video-max/reports.
_comment_whisper_model: faster-whisper model name to load. Defaults to large-v3.
_comment_whisper_device: 'cuda' or 'cpu'. Leave as 'auto' (or omit) to auto-detect from ctranslate2's reported CUDA device count.
_comment_whisper_compute: ctranslate2 compute type, e.g. 'float16' or 'int8'. Leave as 'auto' (or omit) to auto-select: float16 when whisper_device resolves to cuda, int8 when it resolves to cpu.
_comment_max_fps: Frame extraction rate (frames per second) for this package. Default is 5 -- deliberately NOT the 1 fps its lighter sibling uses, because deep study is the point here and on-screen artifacts measured illegible at 1 fps and readable at 5. This key is named max_fps rather than knowledge_fps precisely so that a shared config file can pin watch-video to 1 and watch-video-max to 5 independently. Below 5 the resolver warns rather than clamping.
